answers.core: This is about improving the usability of the GDScript editor for faster creation of variable names and less typos. ;)
answers.workaround:
This might be worked around by an editor plugin but this might be inconvenient.
Better to have a feature like that in the editor right from the start.

title: Editor support for adding a quick way of auto-creating a variable of certain type if calling a function with known return type.
